description:
In order to participate in the Tetra Golden Chip event, Soda ends up donning a bunny outfit.
Unsure if the outfit will bring her good luck, she will nonetheless do her best for Maid For You.

levels.name: Beginner's Rewards
levels.description:
■ Activates when entering Burst Stage 3. Affects all allies.
<color=#00AEFF>Effects vary according to the number of Golden Chip stacks. <word_group=10028>Each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it</word_group>:</color>
Stage 1: With 10 or more stacks of Golden Chip,
<color=#00AEFF>Time Extension I: Full Burst Duration▲ 2 sec. Lasts until Full Burst ends.</color>
Stage 2: With 20 or more stacks of Golden Chip,
<color=#00AEFF>Time Extension II: Full Burst Duration▲ 3 sec. Lasts until Full Burst ends.</color>
■ Activates when performing a normal attack during Full Burst. Affects the 1 enemy unit(s) nearest to the crosshair. 
<color=#00AEFF>Effects vary according to the state of Time Extension. <word_group=10028>Each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it</word_group>:</color>
Stage 1: When in Time Extension I state,
<color=#00AEFF>deals 27.63% of <word_group=10025>final</word_group> ATK as damage.</color>
Stage 2: When in Time Extension II state,
<color=#00AEFF>deals 45.97% of <word_group=10025>final</word_group> ATK as damage.</color>

lines.text: Master! I was waiting for you!

Oh boy, this outfit is a bit tight.
Is there any chance I can get a larger size?

Alice was complimenting me on how cute I looked.
Do you agree?
Why are you looking at me like that? You're making me self-conscious.

Check it out, Master,
I can clean things with my tail!
Good luck to you, Master!

Master, where are you?
You haven't left me, have you?
If you keep disappearing on me, I'm gonna hold onto your arm and never let go.

What beautiful weather we're having.
A perfect day for cleaning.
I miss Cocoa and Ade so much...
Hehe, back to the cafe, home sweet home!
Now you and I are squadmates, Master!
Keep it up!
You think this makes me look cuter?
Wow, this must be the power of luck.

Another gift?
But you've already given me so much...

I want to give you something in return...
How about a lucky letter?
Here, let me try and bestow some luck upon you.
I feel like I can depend on you.

I'm having trouble catching my breath.
Could it be because of this outfit?

Master, I lo... er...
I mean, thank you.
I'll hold the line!
Huh?
Bit by bit...
The battle begins.
I-I can do this!
What if I mess up?
Here we go.
I won't give up!
Oh gosh, I'm so nervous...
Cocoa... Ade...
I'm gonna shine bright!
Ah! Did you see anyone coming?
I will clean it up!
Yeah! It worked!
Cleaning finished!
Lucky bunny!
Woo...
Gasp.
